overall: Los Angeles is currently experiencing classic late-June marine layer conditions, with temperatures locked at 62.6°F since midnight ET (roughly 2 AM local) and zero warming velocity — consistent with deep overcast and patchy coastal fog. The day is trending as expected for a 'June Gloom' pattern: sluggish overnight temperature, southwest onshore flow around 7-10 mph, and mostly cloudy skies that will suppress solar heating well into the late morning or early afternoon.
